note: Midweek W 🏆 Halloween is Saturday (I said Friday before, my bad 💀), so you've got 3 more days of training. Water bottle full, let's go 💧

meals: Avocado toast on whole grain bread with a poached egg and a glass of milk
Thai pad kra pao with minced pork (ask for less sugar), fried egg on top, cucumber on the side
Celery with no-sugar peanut butter, water
Homemade shrimp and veggie tempura with udon soup. Small scoop of matcha ice cream right after
days.tip: Halloween prep: when you get candy on Saturday, pick chocolate over gummies and sour stuff, and eat it right after dinner.

meals: Cheesy scrambled eggs in a warm whole wheat tortilla with avocado, a glass of milk
Turkey and cheese roll-ups with cucumber rounds
Korean bibimbap with beef, spinach, carrots, bean sprouts and a fried egg (go easy on the sweet gochujang)
Plain Greek yogurt with a sprinkle of crushed walnuts
Wood-fired margherita pizza with extra mozzarella and a big rocket salad. Two strawberries and a cube of parmesan right after
days.tip: Sticky sauces like gochujang and ketchup hug your teeth. Swish water after the meal to wash them off.

meals: Japanese breakfast set: grilled salmon, rice, miso soup and a soft-boiled egg
Chicken karaage with salmon onigiri, edamame and crunchy cabbage salad
Plain Greek yogurt with a few blueberries
Sizzling chicken fajitas with peppers, melted cheese, guacamole and sour cream. A small slice of cheesecake right after
days.tip: Halloween is tomorrow! Plan it now: candy goes in one bowl after dinner, then water, then brush. No candy grazing all evening.
